items.title: Henry Johnson interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Nice to be here, Mike. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Mike.

ctx.x: Hello. We are on board the Royal Caribbean cruise line and we are filming a Jazz Archive interview for Hamilton College. We have with us today as our guest Henry Johnson. Pleased to have you.

Let me ask you a few questions about your guitar playing. First of all, I caught your set with Joe Williams, and two things I noticed about your playing. First of all it was really fine playing. I was excited to hear guitar playing that good, that clean, that crisp. But also, that marvelous blues influence in your playing. And it didn’t matter what type of tune it was. There was that authenticity that only comes from a player who understands the blues.
